6.379 rsInvalidBandNavigationReference
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidBandNavigationReference is a critical error that occurs when a
NavigationItem.ReportItemReference element is set to a report item that is outside the body of the
band's nested tablix or in the grouping of the nested tablix or inside a nested tablix that has the
Tablix.Filters element specified.
